description: ETL helper table for decoding tool names

schema.description: The unique ID of the tool
schema.name: tool_id

schema.description: The human readable name of the tool
schema.name: tool_name

schema.description: The timestamp from which the tool is valid
schema.name: valid_from

schema.description: The timestamp until which the tool is valid
schema.name: valid_to

schema.description: The user-provided identifier for the agent
schema.name: agent_id
